name: app-store-compliance
description: Avoid common App Store and Google Play rejections. Open playbook and pre-submission guard with 117 documented rejection patterns and fixes, privacy manifest and Data safety checks, 95 tracked deadlines (EU AI Act, DSA, COPPA, age laws), and a skill for AI coding agents.
one_liner: A checklist-and-guard system that catches the common mistakes that get mobile apps rejected from the Apple and Google app stores, before you submit.
buyer: A solo mobile app developer or small agency that has had an app rejected before and wants to stop losing days to resubmission cycles.
business_use_cases: An indie app developer runs the pre-submission guard before every release to avoid the week-long delay of a rejection.
A mobile dev agency bakes it into their client delivery process so they never ship a client app that bounces at review.
A compliance consultant uses the documented rejection patterns as the basis for a paid app-store readiness audit service.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'pre-submission compliance audit' for indie developers and agencies before they submit to app stores.
Build a hosted dashboard that tracks a team's compliance deadlines (EU AI Act, COPPA, etc.) and charge a monthly fee.

steal_this: Offer indie developers a $49 'will my app get rejected?' pre-submission check this weekend, using this playbook as your checklist.
